label: At D2 after a1->S1, strong if last trial was rewarded a1->S1, fading over the episode
terms: (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) + tv("state", -2) + 2*tv("reward", -2) == 4) ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) + tv("state", -2) + 2*tv("reward", -2) == 4) * (tv("action", -3) + tv("state", -3) + 2*tv("reward", -3) == 4) ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_dec
explanation: Silent at D1 and GO. It fires only at D2 once the agent has chosen a1 and reached S1 (in_state + in_action == 2 is that observed D2 input; the state is now visible, so this is not future information). Its magnitude is set mostly by the previous trial: largest (about 0.3 to 0.4) when the previous trial was also a1 -> S1 rewarded, smaller after any other rewarded trial, and near zero after an unrewarded trial. The a1-S1-rewarded boost shrinks with episode decile (weight about -0.028 per decile), which matches the timing baseline falling to zero after trial 60. The free fit adds a streak term for the trial before, the observer belief_lo and a plain episode-decile term; together they add almost nothing (dev 0.476 vs short 0.467). Belief alone is weaker than the last-trial pattern.

terms: (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) + tv("state", -2) + 2*tv("reward", -2) == 4)
(phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) + tv("state", -2) + 2*tv("reward", -2) == 4) * (tv("action", -3) + tv("state", -3) + 2*tv("reward", -3) == 4)
(phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_dec

issues: The label makes the previous trial being 'rewarded a1->S1' the condition, but what mainly matters is that the previous trial was rewarded at all. In the fitted short form, D2(a1,S1) after any rewarded trial gets +0.162 and the a1-S1-r term adds only +0.034. Scored alone on test: (in)*last_is('a1 S1 r') = 0.211, (in)*(prev_reward==1) = 0.246.

The fading belongs to rewarded trials in general, not to a1-S1-r trials in particular. (in)*(prev_reward==1) ;; (in)*(prev_reward==1)*ep_dec with no last_is scores 0.469 on test, above the recorded 3-term form (0.462). Swapping the recorded ep_dec term for (prev_reward==1)*ep_dec in the same 3-term structure gives 0.485.

Better short form: (in)*(prev_reward==1) ;; (in)*(prev_reward==1)*(prev_common==1) ;; (in)*(prev_reward==1)*ep_trial scores 0.487 on test. The extra boost comes from the previous rewarded trial being common, not from it being a1-S1 specifically. (prev_action==0) adds nothing: 0.469 -> 0.469.
Remaining systematic error, unchanged by any variant tried: at D2 the fit is too high after rare-rewarded previous trials (a1 S2 r -0.036, a2 S1 r -0.023) and after unrewarded ones (about -0.015).

The worst-fit dev windows include early-episode runs of a1-S1-rewarded trials (t1-t8) where the feature is exactly 0 throughout but the fit predicts about 0.2-0.23. Some episodes silence the feature in a way no observed variable here explains.
Belief terms did not help: multiplying the rewarded term by belief or belief_lo in place of ep_dec lowers test R^2 to about 0.26.
Checks that held up: silent at D1 and GO, fires only at D2 after a1->S1, no future variables used.
